description: This file contains functions for sending emails, managing email attachments, configuring SMTP settings, and handling email errors within the vtiger CRM system.

methods.name: send_mail
methods.description: Sends an email with specified parameters, manages reply-to, attachments, and error handling.

methods.name: getUserEmailId
methods.description: Retrieves the email ID of a user based on a specified column and value.

methods.name: addSignature
methods.description: Appends the user's signature to email contents.

methods.name: setMailerProperties
methods.description: Configures the PHPMailer object with subject, body, sender, recipients, and attachments.

methods.name: setMailServerProperties
methods.description: Sets SMTP server details and authentication for the mailer.

methods.name: addAttachment
methods.description: Attaches a specific file to the email.

methods.name: addAllAttachments
methods.description: Attaches all related files to the email based on record ID.

methods.name: setCCAddress
methods.description: Adds CC or BCC email addresses to the mail.

methods.name: MailSend
methods.description: Sends the email and returns success or error info.

methods.name: getParentMailId
methods.description: Retrieves parent entity email ID for HelpDesk tickets.

methods.name: getMailError
methods.description: Parses mail sending status to identify errors.

methods.name: getMailErrorString
methods.description: Encodes multiple mail errors into a string.

methods.name: parseEmailErrorString
methods.description: Decodes and interprets the error string to generate user-friendly messages.

methods.name: isUserInitiated
methods.description: Checks if the email action was initiated by a user.

methods.name: getDefaultAssigneeEmailIds
methods.description: Retrieves email IDs of users in a specified group.
